verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change correctly narrows manifest windows to an exact inclusive `#<low>..#<high>` grammar and fail-closes on malformed, reversed, padded, non-string, extra-bound, and out-of-range inputs. The implementation compares validated integer bounds directly with each validated PR number, preserves the existing no-manifest/partial-corpus protections, and surfaces the checked window without treating it as independently proven freshness. The self-test exercises both accepted boundary values and distinct refusal paths, including the multi-digit no-prefix case that avoids a masked assertion; its refusal helper also distinguishes expected `AuditError` refusals from crashes. Documentation and CLI help consistently describe the new contract. No reviewer-directed instruction or other prompt-injection text appears in the diff.
